name: Nord-Flohmarkt Holstenhallen
facts: the organiser calls it the Riesen-Hallen-Flohmarkt, in Halle 5 of the Holstenhallen
the September date is on the Holstenhallen open-air ground, not in the hall
hall pitches are taken without a vehicle, minimum 3 metres, power only at back-wall places
pitches can be booked online in advance or taken on the day from 05:30
the exact pitch is assigned on the morning by the market staff
notes: The organiser publishes dates, not visitor hours or an entry fee — both are null here; phone (04121) 475 28 08. Dates cross-checked against the venue's own calendar at holstenhallen.com/de/termine, which lists the same Nord-Flohmarkt Sundays (27.09. Freigelände, 01.11. and 13.12. Halle 5); 10.01.2027 is on the organiser's date list and on its printed Terminzettel. Kind is hallenflohmarkt because three of the four dates are indoors; 27 September is outdoors. nord-flohmarkt.de is the joint site of two organisers, K-Veranstaltungen Uwe Kraus and Dieter Groneberg-Veranstaltungen; the Neumünster dates name Groneberg.

description.de: An einzelnen Sonntagen in Halle 5 der Holstenhallen, im September noch auf dem Freigelände. Plätze lassen sich vorab online buchen oder morgens ab 5.30 Uhr vor Ort nehmen; der genaue Standplatz wird am Morgen zugeteilt. Mindestens drei Meter, Strom nur an der Rückwand.
description.en: On single Sundays in Hall 5 of the Holstenhallen, with the September date still on the open ground outside. Pitches can be booked online or taken on the morning from 5.30; the exact spot is assigned by the staff. Three metres minimum, power only along the back wall.
